ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p (TA505/FIN11) LEMURLOOT web shell drop on MOVEit/GoAnywhere (T1190 → T1505.003)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature LEMURLOOT/human2.aspx web shell that Cl0p (GRACEFUL SPIDER) dropped during the 2023 MOVEit Transfer (CVE-2023-34362) and 2023 GoAnywhere MFT (CVE-2023-0669) zero-day campaigns: an ASPX file written into the file-transfer appliance's wwwroot by the IIS worker process w3wp.exe. This is the highest-fidelity Cl0p marker known — they have repeatedly weaponised public-facing file-transfer software as their bespoke initial-access vector (Accellion FTA 2020, SolarWinds Serv-U 2021, GoAnywhere 2023, MOVEit 2023, PaperCut 2023).
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_paths values(Filesystem.file_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action IN ("created","renamed","modified") AND Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitDMZ\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\GoAnywhere\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Serv-U\\*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.jsp" OR Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="LemurLoot*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.process_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p LEMURLOOT — ASPX/JSP written into a file-transfer appliance webroot by the IIS worker process
let KnownWebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","LemurLoot.aspx","_human2.aspx"]);
let AppliancePaths = dynamic([@"\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\", @"\MOVEitDMZ\wwwroot\", @"\GoAnywhere\", @"\Serv-U\"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any (AppliancePaths)
| where FileName endswith ".aspx" or FileName endswith ".jsp" or FileName in~ (KnownWebshellNames)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
    | where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","rundll32.exe")
    | project DeviceId, ChildProcTime = Timestamp, ChildImage = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine
) on DeviceId
| where isempty(ChildProcTime) or ChildProcTime between (Timestamp - 5m .. Timestamp + 1h)  // shell drop +/- IIS reconnaissance child
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildProcTime, ChildImage, ChildCmd
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p LEMURLOOT — ASPX/JSP webshell drop on MOVEit/GoAnywhere/Serv-U via ASIM file-events
let KnownWebshellNames = dynamic(["human2.aspx","lemurloot.aspx","_human2.aspx"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where ActingProcessName endswith "w3wp.exe"
| where TargetFilePath has_any ("MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot", "MOVEitDMZ\\wwwroot", "GoAnywhere", "Serv-U")
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("aspx","jsp") or tolower(TargetFileName) in (KnownWebshellNames)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath,
          TargetFileSHA256, ActorUsername, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Cl0p LEMURLOOT Web Shell Drop on MOVEit / GoAnywhere / Serv-U
id: 9a4b1d52-cf0e-4d63-9b3f-cl0p-lemurloot
status: experimental
description: Detects the Cl0p (TA505/FIN11/GRACEFUL SPIDER) LEMURLOOT web shell being written into a managed file-transfer appliance webroot by the IIS worker process w3wp.exe, the canonical pivot used in the May/June 2023 MOVEit Transfer mass-exploitation campaign (CVE-2023-34362).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/zero-day-moveit-data-theft
author: detection-engineering
date: 2024/01/15
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.003
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - detection.g0092
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    Image|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\'
      - '\MOVEitDMZ\wwwroot\'
      - '\GoAnywhere\'
      - '\Serv-U\'
  selection_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.aspx'
      - '.jsp'
  selection_known:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - 'human2.aspx'
      - 'LemurLoot'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_path and (selection_ext or selection_known)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate vendor patch / hotfix dropping an .aspx into the webroot — correlate with change ticket
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE OR *\\W3wp.exe) (@TargetFilename:(*"\\MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot\\"* OR *"\\MOVEitDMZ\\wwwroot\\"* OR *"\\GoAnywhere\\"* OR *"\\Serv-U\\"*)) (@TargetFilename:(*.aspx OR *.ASPX OR *.jsp OR *.JSP OR *human2.aspx* OR *LemurLoot*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/w3wp\.exe$/i
| regex("(MOVEit Transfer.{1,40}wwwroot|MOVEitDMZ.{1,40}wwwroot|GoAnywhere|Serv-U)", field=TargetFileName)
| TargetFileName=/(\.aspx|\.jsp|human2\.aspx|lemurloot)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| count >= 1
ucs.rationale: Cl0p / TA505 is the ONLY major actor that has repeatedly built initial-access tradecraft around exploiting public-facing managed-file-transfer products and dropping an appliance-specific .aspx/.jsp web shell as its persistence beachhead — Accellion FTA (DEWMODE, 2020), SolarWinds Serv-U (2021), GoAnywhere MFT (2023), MOVEit Transfer (LEMURLOOT/human2.aspx, 2023), and PaperCut (2023). ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p ransomware pre-encryption recovery-disable cluster (T1490) on a single host
ucs.description: Hunts the tightly-clustered sequence of shadow-copy deletion + boot recovery disablement + backup catalog wipe that Cl0p's ransomware deployment script executes immediately before invoking its file-encryption stage. Cl0p's loader (often Truebot/SDBbot delivered post-MOVEit or via Cobalt Strike beacon) chains vssadmin, wmic shadowcopy, bcdedit, and wbadmin in seconds to deny recovery — defenders see this exact bundle in nearly every Cl0p IR engagement.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as commands values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents dc(Processes.process) as distinct_cmds from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*Win32_Shadowcopy*" OR Processes.process="*Get-WmiObject*Win32_Shadowcopy*") AND Processes.user!="*$" by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where distinct_cmds >= 2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
// Cl0p pre-encryption recovery-killer cluster: multiple distinct recovery-disable commands within 10 min on one host
let RecoveryDisableTokens = dynamic([
    "delete shadows",
    "shadowcopy delete",
    "recoveryenabled no",
    "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
    "wbadmin delete catalog",
    "win32_shadowcopy"
]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where CmdLower has_any (RecoveryDisableTokens)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize DistinctCmds = dcount(CmdLower),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 8),
            ParentImages = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 8),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, 10m)
| where DistinctCmds >= 2     // 2+ distinct recovery-kill commands in same 10-min bucket = Cl0p signature
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName, DistinctCmds, SampleCmds, ParentImages
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Cl0p pre-encryption recovery-killer cluster via Windows 4688
let RecoveryDisableTokens = dynamic([
    "delete shadows",
    "shadowcopy delete",
    "recoveryenabled no",
    "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures",
    "wbadmin delete catalog",
    "win32_shadowcopy"
]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| extend CmdLower = tolower(CommandLine)
| where CmdLower has_any (RecoveryDisableTokens)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize DistinctCmds = dcount(CmdLower),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 8),
            Parents = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, 10m)
| where DistinctCmds >= 2
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, Computer, SubjectUserName, DistinctCmds, SampleCmds, Parents
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE OR *\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe) (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"DELETE SHADOWS"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"recoveryenabled NO"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"wbadmin delete catalog"* OR *Win32_Shadowcopy* OR *win32_shadowcopy*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|recoveryenabled\\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures|wbadmin.*delete catalog|win32_shadowcopy)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| UserName!=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ count(field=CommandLine, distinct=true, as=distinct_cmds) | min(_time, as=firstSeen) | max(_time, as=lastSeen) | collect([CommandLine, ImageFileName]) })
| distinct_cmds >= 2
ucs.rationale: While many ransomware crews use vssadmin alone, Cl0p / FIN11's deployment script is notable for chaining FOUR distinct recovery-denial techniques (vssadmin shadow delete, wmic Win32_Shadowcopy delete, bcdedit dual-flag boot tampering, wbadmin catalog wipe) within seconds of each other from a single beachhead, as documented in CISA AA23-158A and multiple Mandiant/Microsoft (Spandex Tempest) IR repo
